items.title: Dave Valentin interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 15, 2000
items.q: I had to chuckle when I was listening to you and Roland Hanna this morning... I told him watch out, I’m half your age... I showed him a little Montuno

ctx.x: No I don’t think so. I had to chuckle when I was listening to you and Roland Hanna this morning. It’s so interesting to hear musicians at these kind of events find a common ground.
